description: This file defines a PHP class 'UserModel' used for serializing 'User' entity data into a structured API response format. It includes OpenAPI schema annotations for documentation and implements methods for filtering and attribute naming related to user data within an HRM system.

classes.name: UserModel
classes.description: A model class responsible for representing user data in API responses, implementing serialization and filtering logic for the User entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserModel with a User entity, and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
